# 0x7C9380 __aulldiv 基准（batch 975）——64 位无符号除法真身模拟
# 格式: CASE a=<hex64> b=<hex64> -> ret=<hex64>
# ret = (uint64)a / (uint64)b，无符号截断，余数丢弃
CASE a=0000000000000000 b=0000000000000001 -> ret=0000000000000000
CASE a=0000000000000001 b=0000000000000001 -> ret=0000000000000001
CASE a=00000000ffffffff b=00000000ffffffff -> ret=0000000000000001
CASE a=0000000100000000 b=0000000000000002 -> ret=0000000080000000
CASE a=0000000100000000 b=0000000100000000 -> ret=0000000000000001
CASE a=123456789abcdef0 b=0000000000010000 -> ret=0000123456789abc
CASE a=ffffffffffffffff b=0000000080000000 -> ret=00000001ffffffff
CASE a=ffffffffffffffff b=0000000000000003 -> ret=5555555555555555
CASE a=ffffffffffffffff b=ffffffffffffffff -> ret=0000000000000001
CASE a=deadbeefcafebabe b=0000000012345678 -> ret=0000000c3b6b4d74
CASE a=deadbeefcafebabe b=123456789abcdef0 -> ret=000000000000000c
CASE a=8000000000000000 b=0000000000000002 -> ret=4000000000000000
CASE a=0000000000000001 b=ffffffffffffffff -> ret=0000000000000000
CASE a=0000000080000000 b=0000000000008000 -> ret=0000000000010000
CASE a=abcdef0123456789 b=00000000fedcba98 -> ret=00000000ac924812
CASE a=0000000000001234 b=0000000000000012 -> ret=0000000000000102
